sections.description:
Short title and commencement

LEGAL FRAMEWORK (REMOVAL OFDIFFICULTY) ORDER, 2002
LEGAL FRAMEWORK
(REMOVAL OFDIFFICULTY) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 41 OF 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part 1, 23rd November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
22-11-2002.-----The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for, general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Order may be called the Legal Framework (Removal
of Difficulty) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

LEGAL FRAMEWORK (REMOVAL OFDIFFICULTY) ORDER, 2002
LEGAL FRAMEWORK
(REMOVAL OFDIFFICULTY) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 41 OF 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part 1, 23rd November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
22-11-2002.-----The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for, general information:-
2. Governor to act as such
till Chief Minister takes oath of his office.-------Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Constitution or any other law for the time being in
force, the Governor shall continue to act as such and shall perform all
functions and exercise all powers of the Chief Minister and pass all
appropriate Orders till the Chief Minister takes oath of office in accordance
with the Constitution.
